title: Towards Continual Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29923v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) relies on vision-language alignment to recognize arbitrary text-defined categories, yet this alignment is fragile under continual test-time distribution shift. Our diagnostic analysis reveals that entropy minimization drives patch-level class collapse, continual updates erode vision-language alignment, and redundant gradients from low-shift samples waste computation. We propose Diversify, Anchor, and Filter (DAF), a stabilization framework that augments entropy-based adaptation with a marginal diversity loss that resists collapse, a cross-modal anchor consistency loss that constrains feature drift relative to a frozen source model, and feature salience filtering that skips low-value backward passes to offset part of the source-anchor overhead. We evaluate on five datasets spanning natural scenes, autonomous driving, underwater imagery, and remote sensing with their corrupted variants. Across

translated_title: 面向开放词汇语义分割中视觉-语言模型的持续测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）依赖于视觉-语言对齐来识别任意由文本定义的类别，然而在持续的测试时分布偏移下，这种对齐十分脆弱。我们的诊断分析揭示：熵最小化会导致补丁级别的类别坍塌，持续更新会侵蚀视觉-语言对齐，而来自低偏移样本的冗余梯度会浪费计算资源。我们提出了多样化、锚定与过滤框架（Diversify, Anchor, and Filter, DAF），该框架在基于熵的自适应基础上增强了三项机制：一种抵抗类别坍塌的边际多样性损失，一种相对于冻结源模型约束特征漂移的跨模态锚定一致性损失，以及一种跳过低价值反向传播以抵消部分源锚定开销的特征显著性过滤。我们在涵盖自然场景、自动驾驶、水下图像和遥感领域及其损坏变体的五个数据集上进行了评估。
tldr: 提出DAF稳定化框架，通过边际多样性损失、跨模态锚定一致性损失和特征显著性过滤，解决开放词汇语义分割在持续测试时分布偏移下的类别坍塌、对齐侵蚀与计算冗余问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DAF, a stabilization framework for continual test-time adaptation of vision-language models in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, which combines marginal diversity loss, cross-modal anchor consistency loss, and feature salience filtering to resist class collapse, constrain feature drift, and reduce redundant computation.
